Fallowborn

Start in the mud. Leave a crown to your heirs.

Fallowborn is a free browser strategy game about dragging one medieval bloodline from serf to emperor - one funeral at a time.

Begin in 867 AD with one of seven beginnings: from landless serf to petty baron. Choose any home across Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. Around you, about 65 rival realms fight their own wars and redraw the map.

How it plays

- Set a focus and let the days run. Farm, trade, train, study, court, scheme, or travel. Pause for choices or skip straight to the next event with automated decisions (no click-spam!).

- Build a household that can survive you. Marry with an eye to station, educate children, put family to work, make allies and rivals, and continue as an heir when death comes.

- Climb by coin, favor, faith, marriage, intrigue, or war. Buy land, run enterprises, rise through a guild or religious calling, press claims, command armies, and siege counties.

- Rule and be ruled. Serve a liege, vote in the estates, manage a royal council and your own vassals, crush revolts, or raise your banner for independence.

Serf → Freeholder → Gentry → Baron → Count → Duke → King → Emperor

Free to play in your browser on desktop and mobile. No download. Autosaves.

English, with AI-translated Preview versions in French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

Community and modding

Bugs, ideas, and dynasty disasters → Discord (https://discord.gg/G8E67hY2pj)

The entire world is plain data → Modding and source (https://github.com/dli9431/fallowborn#modding)

Fallowborn is free forever → Ko-fi (https://ko-fi.com/fallowborn)

Built openly by one person with AI assistance. Source available under the PolyForm Noncommercial License (https://github.com/dli9431/fallowborn#license)—free to play, mod, and share noncommercially.

Enjoyed your dynasty? Rating Fallowborn on itch helps other players find it.
